calculation_handling.description: General conformity rule: no land, building or structure may be used except in conformity with this By-law. It sets no number and is satisfied by the other regulations.
General rule that a building or structure must comply with this By-law. It sets no number of its own.
A lot may not be reduced in area (severance, conveyance, transfer) unless the remainder complies. This is a lot-creation test, not a limit on a parcel as it stands.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs a proposed severance or conveyance scenario; the lot data describe only the lot as it is.

units.disclosure: This rule restricts reducing a lot by severance or conveyance unless the remainder still complies with the By-law. It is not evaluated against the lot as it stands.

calculation_handling.description: After a public-authority conveyance, a lot is deemed to comply with minimum frontage, depth, area or setback if the reduction leaves at least 85% (lot dimensions) or 75% (setback) of the required minimum.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the pre-conveyance lot dimensions and a record of the conveyance; neither is held.

units.disclosure: A lot reduced by a public conveyance is deemed to comply with minimum frontage, depth, area or setback if at least 85% (75% for setbacks) of the required minimum remains. Not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Where a public conveyance reduces the permitted maximum dwelling units or gross floor area, the maximum stays what was permitted the day before the conveyance.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the permitted maximum as of the day before the conveyance; not held.

units.disclosure: If a public conveyance lowers the permitted dwelling units or gross floor area, the earlier permitted maximum is kept. Not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Where a public conveyance removes required parking spaces, the remaining spaces are deemed to satisfy the parking requirements for the building and uses present the day before.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the pre-conveyance building, uses and parking; not held.

units.disclosure: If a public conveyance removes required parking spaces, the remaining spaces are deemed sufficient for the building and uses that existed before. Not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Where a public conveyance pushes a lawfully existing building over the permitted maximum lot coverage, the maximum becomes the coverage on the day of the conveyance; for a vacant lot the maximum is based on the lawful lot area the day before.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs as-built coverage and the pre-conveyance lot area; not held.

units.disclosure: If a public conveyance puts a lawfully existing building over the lot coverage maximum, the coverage on the day of the conveyance becomes the maximum; a vacant lot keeps coverage based on its earlier lawful area. Not evaluated.

2.1.1(1).explanation: No land, building or structure may be used except as this By-law allows. It adds no number of its own.

2.1.1(2).explanation: No building or structure may be used, built or altered if it does not comply with this By-law. It adds no number of its own.

2.1.1(3).explanation: A lot cannot be made smaller by severance, conveyance or transfer unless what remains still complies with this By-law.

2.1.1(4).explanation: When a government conveyance, dedication or expropriation shrinks a lot, the lot is treated as still compliant if at least 85% of the required lot size (75% of the required setback) remains, and the earlier dwelling unit, floor area, parking and lot coverage allowances are preserved as they stood before.
